description: This file implements a utility function 'downloadOrShareBlobBasedOnPlatform' that determines whether to download or share a Blob object based on the platform detected (web or native mobile). It handles platform distinctions such as iOS and Android, invoking appropriate external functions for native mobile sharing or downloading, or a generic download for web.

methods.name: downloadOrShareBlobBasedOnPlatform
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the platform and either initiates a data download or shares the Blob via native sharing options, based on the platform and application context.
